name: PT Mayora Indah Tbk
summary: PT Mayora Indah Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of food and beverage products in Indonesia, the rest of Asia, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Packaged Food Processing, Packaged Beverages Processing, and Financial Services. It offers biscuits under the Danisa, Slai O Lai, Zuperrr Keju, Coffee Joy, Better, Royal Choice, Roma Sari Gandum, Roma Biskuit Kelapa, Roma Marie Susu, Roma Malkist, Rome Wafers, and Roma filled Cookies brands names; confectionery products under the Kopiko, KIS/ FRESH MINT, KIS mint Chewy2, and Tamarins brand names; and wafers under the ASTOR, ASTOR Skinny roll, and Beng-Beng Regular brand names.
